rules: Query capability before admitting a grid above the legacy cap.
Use opcode 9 only if a PID or extent exceeds 65535; opcode 3 remains byte-identical otherwise.
Never silently truncate an axis or infer support from a compile profile.
Apply admission before argument allocation or kernel execution.
Existing bounded unfinished queue and role-SPMD looping remain in force.
This extension decodes wide metadata; it does not introduce a physical multicore dispatcher.
